products.name: WriteBackExtreme and InputTables
products.description: The Enterprise-only write-back suite that turns a Tableau dashboard into a planning and data-correction tool: WriteBackExtreme stores forecasts, budgets, targets, comments, approvals and corrections in the customer's own database with audit trail, rollback, role management and SSO, and InputTables adds Excel-like cell-level entry, comments and dynamic columns inside a SuperTable. Use cases are planning and forecasting, what-if scenarios, data correction, surveys, annotations, task lists and approvals. Available on the Enterprise plan only (SaaS or on-premises with no internet required), with a 30-day WriteBackExtreme trial in a personal cloud environment; also shipped as a Power BI custom visual.

products.name: SuperTables
products.description: The Excel-like interactive grid for Tableau and Power BI dashboards: pivot, grouping, conditional formatting, formulas, totals, Excel export, personalised saved views and a server-side row model for millions of rows, plus generative fill through the AI services. The product that makes Tableau accessible to Excel-minded users (Post Holdings, 1,000+ Tableau users), included in the Free plan for 1-5 users and scaling through Professional (up to 100 users, cloud, annual billing) to Enterprise (unlimited users, SaaS or on-premises). Available as a Tableau dashboard and viz extension and as a Power BI custom visual on Microsoft AppSource.

products.name: FinanceTables

Combines with WriteBackExtreme for budget entry and with MailScheduler and VizSlides for month-end distribution; available on Professional and Enterprise plans.

Reaches executives and other non-Tableau users where they work and replaces manual export-and-send routines; installed as a server component alongside the extensions with SSO and role management.
